claim: Craig Newmark is the American internet entrepreneur and comedian who founded the company featured on 24 Hours on Craigslist.
evidencia:
Page: 24 Hours on Craigslist. Sentence: 24 Hours on Craigslist is a 2005 American feature-length documentary that captures the people and stories behind a single day's posts on the classified ad website Craigslist.
Page: 24 Hours on Craigslist. Sentence: The film, made with the approval of Craigslist's founder Craig Newmark, is woven from interviews with the site's users, all of whom opted in to be contacted by the production when they submitted their posts on August 4, 2003.
Page: Craig Newmark. Sentence: Craig Alexander Newmark (born December 6, 1952) is an American Internet entrepreneur best known for being the founder of the San Francisco-based international website Craigslist.
